Bill.BriefDescription: Vesting after five years of service in the defined benefit portion of the public employees' retirement system, the school employees' retirement system, and the teachers' retirement system plan 3.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to vesting after five years of service in thedefined benefit portion of the public employees' retirement system, theschool employees' retirement system, and the teachers' retirementsystem plan 3; and amending RCW 41.32.875, 41.35.680, and 41.40.820.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 41.32.875 and 2000 c 247 s 903 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) NORMAL RETIREMENT. Any member who is at least age sixtyfiveand who has((: (a))) completed ((ten)) five service credit years((; or (b) Completed five service credit years, including twelve servicecredit months after attaining age fiftyfour; or (c))) or completed five service credit years by July 1, 1996, underplan 2 and who transferred to plan 3 under RCW 41.32.817((;))shall be eligible to retire and to receive a retirement allowancecomputed according to the provisions of RCW 41.32.840. (2) EARLY RETIREMENT. Any member who has attained at least agefiftyfive and has completed at least ten years of service shall beeligible to retire and to receive a retirement allowance computed p. 1 SB 5517according to the provisions of RCW 41.32.840, except that a memberretiring pursuant to this subsection shall have the retirementallowance actuarially reduced to reflect the difference in the numberof years between age at retirement and the attainment of age sixtyfive. (3) ALTERNATE EARLY RETIREMENT. Any member who has completed atleast thirty service credit years and has attained age fiftyfive shallbe eligible to retire and to receive a retirement allowance computedaccording to the provisions of RCW 41.32.840, except that a memberretiring pursuant to this subsection shall have the retirementallowance reduced by three percent per year to reflect the differencein the number of years between age at retirement and the attainment ofage sixtyfive.
